relatedSnapshot.title: TRPCError: Invalid or expired API key for provider <uuid>. Please update your Company Four credentials.
AI Growth Consultant not reflecting updated niche
relatedSnapshot.description:
**Problem:**

The AI Growth Consultant reads the user's niche from a stale data source (onboardingAIChatSessionTable) that is never updated when users change their niche via Settings or re-submit onboarding. Updates go to organizationKnowledgeTable, but the AI chat still reads from the legacy table.

**Root Cause:**

* lib/chat/onboarding-context.ts (lines 61-63) queries onboardingAIChatSessionTable
* updateNicheOfferSettings in trpc/routers/organizations.ts updates organizationKnowledgeTable
* These are different tables - no sync between them
* Additionally, Redis cache (30min TTL) is not cleared on niche updates

**Fix Required:**

1. Update getUserOnboardingContext() in lib/chat/onboarding-context.ts to read from organizationKnowledgeTable instead of onboardingAIChatSessionTable
2. Clear the onboarding context cache (clearOnboardingContextCache) after niche updates in updateNicheOfferSettings

relatedSnapshot.title: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (requestAnimationFrame) on quality-control page
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Error

`TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'requestAnimationFrame')`

**Sentry:** ATHENA-Z | **Culprit:** `/dashboard/:organizationSlug/quality-control`

## Name 13

| Field | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Events | 640 |
| Affected users | 17 |
| First seen | 2026-03-07 |

---

## Root Cause

The crash originates in `components/ai-sdr/email-list.tsx` (`EmailListVirtualized`), not a quality-control page. No `/quality-control` route exists in this repository — the Sentry culprit is a routing alias for the AI SDR inbox.

**Crash sequence:**

1. `EmailListVirtualized` mounts, emails load
2. `useEffect` fires → `rowVirtualizer.scrollToIndex(0, { align: 'start' })`
3. `scrollToIndex` → `tryScroll` → `this.targetWindow.requestAnimationFrame(callback)` — RAF is now pending
4. User navigates away → component unmounts
5. `useLayoutEffect` cleanup → `cleanup()` → `this.targetWindow = null` (but `elementsCache` is NOT cleared)
6. RAF callback fires next frame → `isDynamicMode()` returns `true` (because `elementsCache.size > 0`) → `this.targetWindow!.requestAnimationFrame(verify)` → **CRASH**

Two `<mention>/virtual-core` v3.13.18 defects combine: non-null assertion inside async RAF callback, and `cleanup()` nulling `targetWindow` without clearing `elementsCache`.

## Fix

`components/ai-sdr/email-list.tsx` — remove the redundant `scrollToIndex` call. The `parentRef.current.scrollTop = 0` line already resets scroll position; `scrollToIndex(0)` is redundant and schedules the crashing RAF.

```tsx
// Before:
React.useEffect(() => {
  if (parentRef.current && emails.length > 0) {
    parentRef.current.scrollTop = 0;
    rowVirtualizer.scrollToIndex(0, { align: 'start' }); // ← remove
  }
}, [emails.length, rowVirtualizer]);

// After:
React.useEffect(() => {
  if (parentRef.current && emails.length > 0) {
    parentRef.current.scrollTop = 0;
  }
}, [emails.length]);
```

## Codebase Verification

Confirmed in codebase:

* `components/ai-sdr/email-list.tsx` lines 138–145: `useEffect` calls both `scrollTop = 0` and `scrollToIndex(0)` with `rowVirtualizer` in deps — exact match
* No open PR on branch `pieter/eng-6370-*`
* No existing unit tests for this component (browser lifecycle issue — not unit-testable)
* Fix is 1 file, 2 lines changed

## Agent Feasibility

**Selected for implementation.**

Requirements are unambiguous, scope is 1 file, 2 lines. The fix eliminates the RAF scheduling that causes the crash on unmount. No tests can be written (RAF timing requires a real browser). No external services involved.

<!-- preview-url-start -->
**Preview:** <url:typeerror-cannot-read-properties-of-null-aiacquisition.vercel.app> — PR #3054
<!-- preview-url-end -->
